Using \(x=r\cos\theta\) and \(y=r\sin\theta\),

\[
V=\frac12 k(x^2+y^2)+\frac32 kx^2
=2kx^2+\frac12ky^2.
\]

Comparing with a two-dimensional harmonic oscillator,

\[
V=\frac12m\omega_x^2x^2+\frac12m\omega_y^2y^2,
\]

gives

\[
\omega_x=2\sqrt{\frac km},\qquad \omega_y=\sqrt{\frac km}.
\]

Therefore,

\[
E_{n_x,n_y}
=\hbar\omega_x\left(n_x+\frac12\right)
+\hbar\omega_y\left(n_y+\frac12\right)
=\left(2n_x+n_y+\frac32\right)\hbar\sqrt{\frac km}.
\]

Answer: D
